title: Myth vs. Fact: Does Boiling Water Clear Grease Clogs?
description: A common myth in household maintenance is that pouring boiling water down a clogged kitchen sink permanently dissolves grease blockages. While hot water can temporarily melt fat deposits near the drain opening, it cools rapidly as it travels through cold subterranean or under-sink piping. This causes the liquefied grease to congeal deeper within the drainage network, turning a minor fixture issue into a major main-line obstruction. Furthermore, extremely high temperatures can compromise plastic pipe joints or thin wall trap assemblies. Mechanical scraping or proper drain cleaning tools remain the professional method for thorough grease removal.

Myth vs. Fact: Does Boiling Water Clear Grease Clogs?

A common myth in household maintenance is that pouring boiling water down a clogged kitchen sink permanently dissolves grease blockages. While hot water can temporarily melt fat deposits near the drain opening, it cools rapidly as it travels through cold subterranean or under-sink piping. This causes the liquefied grease to congeal deeper within the drainage network, turning a minor fixture issue into a major main-line obstruction. Furthermore, extremely high temperatures can compromise plastic pipe joints or thin wall trap assemblies. Mechanical scraping or proper drain cleaning tools remain the professional method for thorough grease removal.
